commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
90' 4 - 0 Goal - 4:0! Lamine Yamal laid the ball off to Ferran Torres (Barcelona), who shot from close range low into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Jose Sanchez wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
90' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Ferran Torres (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
89' Unlucky! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) hits a thunderous volley on the edge of the box that just flies over the bar.
87' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
85' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
85' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Unai Simon is alert and denies him with a nice save.
84' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Barcelona) leaps to collect the ball.
82' Fine attempt! Raphinha (Barcelona) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
81' Substitution. Dani Olmo walks off the pitch and Raphinha (Barcelona) comes on as a substitute.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.

80' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt under the bar fails to beat Joan Garcia, who makes a sensational save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Dro Fernandez (Barcelona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
79' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) tries to find Lamine Yamal, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
77' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
75' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar.
74' Substitution. Eric Garcia will be replaced by Marc Bernal (Barcelona).
73' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
73' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
71' Barcelona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
71' An attempted cross from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Alex Berenguer and he is replaced by Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao).
68' The substitution has been made. Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) has replaced Mikel Jauregizar.
66' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Jose Sanchez had a clear view and blows his whistle.
66' Barcelona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
65' Close! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
64' Here is a change. Fermin Lopez is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Marc Casado (Barcelona).
64' Substitution. Dro Fernandez (Barcelona) on for Robert Lewandowski.
64' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner.
61' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
61' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
59' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
58' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
58' Wonderful movement by Barcelona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
56' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Unai Gomez is replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nico Williams trots off the pitch and is replaced by Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao).
55' Ernesto Valverde decides to make a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) will be replaced by Alejandro Rego.
54' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.
53' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao)! Let's see what he decides.
53' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Sanchez had an easy-decision to make.
48' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Eric Garcia tees up Fermín (Barcelona) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Unai Simon.
48' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
46' Hansi Flick has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ronald Araujo comes on the pitch for Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
46' The whistle blows and Jose Sanchez starts the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Lamine Yamal shows great vision to find Ferran Torres (Barcelona) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails low into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
45+2' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Jose Sanchez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
41' Yuri Berchiche rounds off a good move with a layoff to Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
39' What a chance that is! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
37' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
35' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) brings his opponent down. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Looks like Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
29' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
26' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
24' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
22' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
18' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
14' Ath Bilbao work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
14' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
13' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Ath Bilbao force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
11' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
9' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
9' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Unai Simon, who smothers the ball.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
3' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
2' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
2' Joan Garcia displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
Jose Sanchez will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
